panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (a, b, c, d). a: Left-profile clinical photograph of a child showing facial pityriasis rosea lesions oriented along lines of skin cleavage. Facial involvement and cleavage-line orientation are explicitly captioned and match the atypical presentation described in the article title. Real human-patient image. b: Frontal clinical photograph of the same child showing facial pityriasis rosea lesions oriented along skin cleavage lines. Caption and in-text explicitly support the cleavage-line orientation on the face, an atypical distribution. Real human-patient image. c: Right-profile clinical photograph showing pityriasis rosea lesions on the face and neck oriented along skin cleavage lines. In-text confirms small oval papules on face and neck with cleavage-line orientation. Atypical facial presentation. Real human-patient image. d: Clinical photograph of the trunk showing truncal pityriasis rosea patches. In-text describes circular slightly scaly patches...

in_text_mentions: Dermatological examination revealed multiple small oval papules 0.5-1 cm in diameter distributed on face and neck and some circular slightly scaly patches 4-5 cm in diameter over his back (Figure 1). Some lesions were orientated along lines of skin cleavage. Mucosal surfaces, palms, soles and scalp were normal.
